summary: After the shebang add a single copyright line and one-line GPLv3+ license declaration, without a year, and don't add extra copyright lines or edit existing headers without permission.
questions: What copyright header should a new module have?
Should I add a copyright year to my module?
Can I add my name to the copyright of an existing module?

answer_card.title: Module copyright and license header
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
#!/usr/bin/python

# Copyright: Contributors to the Ansible project
# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
```
- One-line license, not the full GPL preamble.
- No year; don't edit an existing year.
- Don't add extra copyright lines or change the header without the author's permission.
